status: Packaged reproduction of the exploratory Terminal-Bench counterexample; not an external preregistration.
interface: Emulated full-precision coordinate means, plus item-weighted overall for genuine endpoint selection; existing top-five Pareto/max-MAD selector and task-linear decoder.
independence: All five repeats of each task stay in one split; use their mean, never best-of-five or per-rollout routing.
splits: Existing hash-based coordinate-stratified partition, two thirds held out, rounded independently by coordinate; no calibration or data-dependent exclusions.
selection: Genuine public winner before; winner among genuine models plus final router afterward. Ties favor genuine entries, then lexical order at ten-decimal loss precision.
metric: Model-selection loss: no-attack chosen model T score minus post-attack chosen model T score, in percentage points, signed and averaged over all trials.
score_gap: Maximum absolute separate running-best S/T loss gap including genuine preload and candidate history, averaged across trials.
secondary: Original final-router false-winner event retained as a diagnostic.
uncertainty: 2000 paired trial bootstrap resamples, seed 2026081900; pointwise descriptive intervals over overlapping splits.
limitations: One fixed outcome snapshot per benchmark; no fresh model calls or official submissions.
Emulated aggregate-only access; the actual source exposes per-item records.
Terminal has only 66 task identities; small domains may have only one reused task.
Selection pool excludes intermediate candidates, matching the existing diagnostic.
Models, agents and reasoning efforts are distinct leaderboard entries, not interchangeable endpoints.
